ai_summary: Ambika Cotton Mills Limited announced a repeated delay in the arrival of critical plant and machinery (6480 spindles) essential for an almost-completed project, now expected on September 13th due to persistent feeder vessel space issues. This directly postpones the project's full commissioning, potentially impacting the timeline for realizing increased production capacity or operational efficiencies. The series of logistical delays, without explicit mitigation strategies, highlights a dependency on external supply chain factors that could affect project timelines and associated financial benefits.
